summary: Keep an opening conversation subscription through brief owner transport failures

replay.detail: No claim or replay changes. Initial retries capture a fresh page and replay boundary together.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or coordinated fleet upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: The collections protocol is unchanged. After an admitted remote conversation subscription's first failed opening read, retries for remote-unavailable may start during the next three seconds. This bounds retry starts, not outage visibility: an in-flight stalled retry retains the normal peer RPC deadline, about 15 seconds, before reporting resync. Slow successful reads are not canceled by the retry-start window. Persistent outages still report resync. Other refusals and established subscriptions keep their existing behavior.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond a normal daemon upgrade.

manual.detail: No configuration or migration steps required.

recovery.detail: No persistent changes are introduced; existing binary swap-back behavior is unchanged.
